class.name: IdeamToolContext
class.brief_description: Shared session context carried by Tier 2 Ideam workspaces and composable Tier 3+ bridges.
class.description: Holds the active [Theme], [IdeamUndoRedo] wrapper, active asset reference, dirty-asset flags, and the global [enum UpdateCommitPolicy] governing whether Tier 1 controls mutate data live, on drag release, or on explicit trigger.

method.name: set_undo_redo
method.description: Assigns the shared undo/redo wrapper used by Tier 1 controls hosted in this context.

method.name: set_active_theme
method.description: Applies a new workspace theme and emits [signal theme_changed].

method.name: get_active_theme_index
method.description: Returns the index of the active theme in the ThemeRegistry.

method.name: set_active_asset
method.description: Sets the active asset currently focused in the workspace and emits [signal active_asset_changed].

method.name: mark_asset_dirty
method.description: Marks or clears the unsaved-changes state for [param asset] and emits [signal asset_dirty_changed].

method.name: is_asset_dirty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param asset] has uncommitted or unsaved changes.

method.name: has_any_dirty_assets
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any tracked asset in this session is marked dirty.

method.name: clear_all_dirty
method.description: Clears the dirty flag on all tracked assets.

method.name: trigger_explicit_rebuild
method.description: Emits [signal explicit_rebuild_triggered] so heavy solvers or simulations recompute on demand.

members.member: Controls when interactive Tier 1 edits commit to underlying resources. Defaults to [constant UPDATE_ON_COMMIT] so an entire drag gesture produces one atomic undo action.

signal.name: theme_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the active workspace theme changes.

signal.name: active_asset_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the focused asset in the workspace changes.

signal.name: asset_dirty_changed
signal.description: Emitted when an asset's dirty state changes.

signal.name: explicit_rebuild_triggered
signal.description: Emitted when the user explicitly requests a solver or simulation rebuild.

constants.constant: Mutate the underlying resource continuously during pointer drags.
Preview changes visually during drag and commit one atomic undo/redo action on release (default).
Stage edits and wait for an explicit Execute/Rebuild/Step button press before recomputing.
